notes.title: DIY Dress-up Event
notes.content:
Dear miniBONG players,

It has been a week since the release of "miniBONG" and we believe that many of you have made significant progress and started customizing your characters. We have opened a DIY event on the Steam community and Discord channel, hoping that everyone's DIY creations can be showcased more!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44143411/62f6419a7f100a83c561bb3c5ce7e727959a3252.png[/img]

[i][b]☆ Event Duration ★[/b][/i]
(UTC+8) Starting now - June 18, 2023

[i][b]☆ Announcement of Winners ★[/b][/i]
(UTC+8) June 20th, 12:00 PM

[i][b]☆ Event Rules ★[/b][/i]
1. DIY your character and share it.
2. The default character appearance will not be considered valid for participation.
3. Sharing multiple DIY creations will still count as one entry.
4. Any act of plagiarism or unauthorized use of others' creations will not be considered valid for participation.
5. Participation in the event requires owning the game.

[i][b]☆ Event Platforms ★[/b][/i]
You can upload your creations to the "Artwork" section of the "miniBONG" community on Steam.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44143411/b52f6be2383746599866ab7bf352d15aa864e264.png[/img]
Alternatively, you can share your creations in the "diy-workshop" channel of the Discord server "GINI_OfficialChannel"!
▶▷▶Discord: https://discord.gg/agFYbP8k
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44143411/657b8e10178d4e623d6686d97f6f7834880013c9.png[/img]

[i][b]☆ Event Rewards ★[/b][/i]
Successful participation grants you a chance to win 5000 JPY Steam Gift Cards!
(A total of 2 Steam gift cards with a value of 5000 JPY will be given away)
*Note:
· This event will be conducted in multiple language versions, and the prizes are not specific to each language version. The total reward is 2 Steam gift cards with a value of 5000 JPY each.
· 5000 JPY is approximately equal to 35.92 USD. We apologize for any inconvenience caused as we are unable to fully cover all currencies due to variations, the exchange rate on the day of conversion applies.

Thank you all for your support of miniBONG.
Wishing you all a pleasant gaming experience!

GINI

notes.title: Updata
notes.content:
We have discovered that there may be errors when archiving and saving under unknown circumstances. We have protected it to ensure that it does not occur again, and have added a file called SaveError.log that will be generated when an error is reported. We hope you can provide us with this information. If you unfortunately report an error that caused the archive to disappear, please go to the archive folder to check which archive disappeared. There are a total of 2 archive files, Tminibong and minibong. If Tminibong disappears, you can create an archive with the same name and replace the new archive with the old minibong, so that you can recover the loss.

The archive folder can obtain the path for exporting images through customs clearance. Please go to the resource manager to view it yourself.
Added the ability to participate in battles and rest, effective after restarting levels
Fixed information display error caused by clicking on the back decoration
Fixed that the character selection status will not disappear when the mouse is removed from the avatar
